notes.title: Assault to Yourmomdy reaches new depths
notes.content:
Version 0.9938 is here with a flag contest mode which is a mini Battle Royale for the ownership of each flag. [b]The match is not just ONE BATTLE ROYALE but MANY BATTLE ROYALES[/b]! How about that battle royale games! How many battle royales can you fit into a match >:D 

Tanks![b] That can jump[/b] and have [b]jetpacks[/b]! With [b]Nukes [/b]and [b]shotguns[/b]!

How about projectiles instead of hitscan weapons? [u]Destructible landscape![/u]

Guided missiles, mines, turrets, mortar traps.

Five tank classes!

Get the [b]free demo[/b] now or the full game! Costs you the amount of an adult beverage to keep this hobby project going.

Updates:
- Nukes more expensive
- Inertia nullifier cheaper
- Maneuverability adjustments
- Ships moved closer in Jormandy
- Contest mode: scoring system tuned to favor winnings instead of owning flags
-
